title: Great idea, mixed implementation
text:
First month I got London Calling, great album. No complaints. It's a good pressing, and sounds great.

Second month, Bitches Brew by Miles Davis. Again, great album, but I already have a good copy. Checked multiple times per day to see what album was next on the website, and when it finally showed what it was, it was too late to cancel. Like, couldn't have been more than a couple hours between checking and it was unable to cancel the shipment. I'm not sure if I'll be returning it, or gifting one of the copies, but a little heads up with time to cancel if not wanted would have been super awesome.

From what I've seen in the comments of what others are getting, it looks like largely good selections. A few duds (picture disks aren't for everyone), but a good variety of music to flesh out a collection. Having a few hundred albums already, I suspect this subscription is going to be a bit hit and miss. I hope they can work the bugs out and maybe find a way to link a Discogs account.

Update: Kind of swung the other way on timing. This time I got notification of what it was going to be at the end of September, it isn't going to ship until sometime in November. Exile on Main Street is a solid choice, and I don't already own it. But what's the point of a Vinyl of the Month Club if it is ordered one month and shows up two months later. Maybe a button to say yes I want this or skip this month with a couple of days before it auto ships would be better. Then, it should also be something in stock. I get the supply chain issues are a problem right now for vinyl, I've got half a dozen pre-orders pending for things, but I know the warehouse can't be completely devoid of things that are in stock.
label: positive
